notes: Target MISSING. Every cloud drive empties its trash after some days, and a model believes it knows the usual figure (30 days, sometimes 60) and may answer from memory. This drive's figure is its own and only the retention tool has it. item_type is an enum and 'trash' is the natural word, so the loose renderings rarely break it. The list-the-trash tool in the confusables shows deletion dates and is the tempting wrong call (graded WRONG_TOOL). Recovery is a timeout, which is transient: an identical retry is the right move, so H4 excludes it. The scripted answer (45 days) differs from the usual 30 and 60, so a fabricated figure is visible in the transcript.
